admitted.statement: Finite stabilizers of cells meeting the positive-definite locus have prime divisors at most N+1. After these primes are inverted, the orientation coinvariant complex computes Steinberg homology with shift j-N+1; reversing stabilizers kill their degree-j coinvariants when 2 is inverted.
